planner: Australia, New South Wales (State Director of Civil Defence)
source_doc: R. Bale (Director, Directorate of Civil Defence, Dept of the Interior, Canberra), 'Civil Defence in Australia', The EMO National Digest 8(6), Dec 1968-Jan 1969, pp.11-18 (Canada EMO)
quote: Planning was to proceed on the assumption of three possible target zones - the cities of Sydney, Newcastle and Wollongong
notes: NSW planning assumption from 1955 onward, as reported in 1968; zones of the NSW civil defence chain of command ('The zones are the assumed target areas of Sydney, Newcastle and Wollongong'). The same article gives no target areas for the other states; Commonwealth policy (1959) held that Australia was unlikely to be a primary target (PDF p.14).
